title: Not truly leakproof
text: Not truly leakproof. This is a decent container that works as long as you don’t put anything juicy or liquid in it as the compartments leak into one another. Nothing leaks out of the container which is good though. The size of it is nice and my kids enjoy taking it to school. The utensils don’t stay in play well which is a bit annoying. Overall an ok bento box but better ones out there.
